clarifications_needed: Geography: playbook names VT/NH/NY/MI/MT as primary geographies for regional independents but does not explicitly exclude CO/UT/WA/ID mid-market independents; handbook names CO/UT as BN territory overlap — confirm whether CO/UT independents are in scope for cold outbound given dark-sky-ordinance complexity

Size-band proxy: skier visits is the playbook's scoping metric (75K–300K core, 300K–800K large mid-market) but is not queryable in standard enrichment databases — employee/revenue bands below are a working hypothesis (50–500 employees; $10M–$75M) for operator validation

Conglomerate-owned properties inside the skier-visit band: several Alterra/Boyne properties fall in the 75K–800K band — confirm whether property-level outbound is allowed when the GM has direct vendor authority, or conglomerate ownership is a hard exclusion
Seed accounts are draft exemplars pruned of known Vail/Alterra-owned resorts; validate current ownership and existing-client status before list-building (resort M&A churns yearly)

intent_signals: ownership transition or new GM appointment in last 12 months (SAM Snow People column)
Indy Pass member resort (strongest independent mid-market ICP proxy per playbook)
new village F&B tenant announcement in regional press
compression-week programming press release (NYE, Presidents Week, MLK) in Oct–Nov
bad-snow-year ancillary revenue decline press coverage
base-lodge refresh or village-infrastructure capital announcement
exclusions: Boyne Resorts corporate flagships with centralized RFP motion
Powdr Corp properties with enterprise procurement gates
properties with fewer than 75K annual skier visits (limited village, limited F&B)
on-mountain-only or day-trip ski areas without branded village or base-area F&B operations

large-mid-market-independent.display: Large Mid-Market Independent Ski Resorts (300K–800K visits)
intent_signals: village or base-area capital expansion announcement (new public square, pedestrian plaza, village development)
ownership transition to local investor group in last 24 months
new GM or Sr Director Village Operations appointment in last 12 months (SAM Snow People)
multi-season shoulder or summer programming investment announcement
village F&B tenant expansion or new concept opening
compression-week premium ticket or village-event programming announcement in Oct–Nov
Indy Pass membership or Indy Pass+ designation
exclusions: Vail Resorts portfolio properties (e.g., Stowe, Okemo, Mount Snow, Hunter Mountain)
Alterra Mountain Company portfolio properties (e.g., Sugarbush, Stratton)
Boyne Resorts flagships with centralized procurement
properties above 800K annual skier visits (enterprise flagship ceiling — Breckenridge, Park City)
resorts without a dedicated village or base-area pedestrian zone with F&B operations
